en.title: Palindromic Substrings Counted by Position
en.description:
Count all palindromic substrings; substrings with the same characters but different start or end positions are counted separately. The first sentence of the source is truncated; this definition is made clear by the title and by the example in which aaa lists six positional substrings.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: One line with a lowercase string of length 1..1000.
en.explanation: Example 1: three single characters, 3 in total. Example 2: three a, two aa and one aaa, 6 in total. Example 3: four single characters plus bb and abba, 6 in total.
hints: Enumerate odd and even centers and expand to both sides until the characters differ; each successful expansion counts one palindrome.
